lint.details: No lint command configured in services.yaml or package.json

nonBlockingIssues.description: Misleading comment in execution-loop.ts about cancelled status mapping — PhaseInfo has no cancelled status, comment should reflect this
Duplicated 4-site milestone injection check pattern in execution-loop.ts could be extracted to a helper
Minor double-indexing inefficiency — createValidationPhases assigns indices that are immediately recalculated by injectValidationPhasesIfNeeded
String prefix constants ('Scrutiny: ', 'Validation: ') for phase detection could be shared between milestone-tracker.ts and stage-loop-factory.ts
Test 'only includes configured commands in hard gates' has incomplete assertions — doesn't verify unconfigured commands are absent from hard gate sections
CommandsSchema in loader.ts does not apply shell metacharacter validation (defense-in-depth, not a security risk since commands are executed by workers)
Production integration builds ContractAssertion objects with generic titles/descriptions from bare IDs rather than parsing validation-contract.md — worker must read the contract independently
Stage-loop-factory routing tests are structural (string prefix matching) rather than integration-level, consistent with existing patterns but wouldn't catch factory wiring regressions
FailedAssertion.status typed as string rather than narrower union type ('pending' | 'failed' | 'blocked')
Gate failure reason string uses \n formatting that may render oddly in some UI contexts
checkEndOfSessionGate is synchronous but EndOfSessionGateCheck type requires async wrapping — small adapter gap, only used in tests currently

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add skip_scrutiny and skip_validation config flags to the Configuration table with their env var overrides (FLYWHEEL_SKIP_SCRUTINY, FLYWHEEL_SKIP_VALIDATION) and the commands section (test, typecheck, lint)
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Features validation-phase-auto-injection and scrutiny-validation-phase added these config options but they are not documented in the user-facing AGENTS.md configuration reference

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add validation phase title prefix convention ('Scrutiny: ' and 'Validation: ') to the Plan File Format or Pipeline section, explaining that these prefixes trigger special prompt routing in stage-loop-factory.ts
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Features scrutiny-validation-phase and behavioral-validation-phase both use string prefix matching for routing, but this convention is not documented anywhere

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the end-of-session gate as a new pipeline gate category (post-all-stages, pre-completion) in the Pipeline and execution section. Note that the EndOfSessionGateCheck callback in PipelineOptions is infrastructure-ready but not yet wired into production TUI code paths.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature end-of-session-gate adds a new gate type that is distinct from inter-stage gates, but the pipeline documentation only describes inter-stage gates

rejectedObservations.reason: These are different systems (Factory services.yaml vs Flywheel config). The parallel was noted by the reviewer but no action is needed since they serve different purposes.
